text: Only the weights of the recovered lead chromate precipitates need be known because the concentration of the lead carrier solution cancels out of the algebraic equations. An effort was made to detect the presence of any radioactive impurities in the tracer by separating the lead-210 and the bismuth-210 by anion exchange. The 15b-counting of the lead-210 fraction began within a few minutes of completing the separation. Only the weight of the recovered lead chromate precipitates is important because the concentration of the lead carrier solution cancels out of the equations.
